message.text: Taken: the minion already working in chat.js is adding markdown rendering for chat messages, using the framework's existing `.md()` renderer. Bold, lists, headings, code and links will render, and raw HTML will be escaped. I'll report when it lands.

Landed, live and uncommitted: chat messages now render markdown through the framework's existing renderer. I confirmed no failed requests at 1920, but the minion's report was cut off before its markdown details, so glance at a bold word and a list in the chat.

Card chat messages already render markdown (chat.js uses md_into). The Live card's agent transcript (live.js line 386) still draws plain text, so it is queued behind the layout work and will be done in the same minion. That pass will also check that bold and links render on new-card and that a backtick doesn't break the page.
Done, live and uncommitted: the Live card's transcript now renders markdown too, through the same renderer the card chat uses. Card chats already did.

Landed, live and uncommitted: each chat message now has a small uppercase role label on its own line above the text, once per message. It is in the card chats (replies and ask bubbles too) and in the Live transcript. It reads You, Assistant, Manager, Master assistant or Minion. The colours come from existing theme tokens. The minion's report was cut off before its light and dark check, so look at both.
